opening.argument: The video promotes a no-investment money-making application, instructing viewers to download it while claiming, “Without any investment you can earn a good amount of money from this application” and “Per day you can earn about 10$.” It provides an app link and referral-code entry, then frames gameplay and referrals as routes to rewards, including an invitation promising 10 Handy. Participation requires entering a phone number and six-digit PIN, and withdrawal is subject to restrictive conditions: the video says the minimum withdrawal is 10 Handy, while the displayed screen shows 110 Handy available against a 1,000 Handy minimum, plus a 100 Handy fee, with withdrawal unavailable. These features present a low-barrier path to acquiring money or assets, although the available evidence does not establish that users were paid or lost money.
